channel.title: Filtored Patch Notes
channel.description: New features, improvements, and fixes in every Filtored AI Gallery release.

item.title: Version 3.2.0
item.dc:creator: Filtored
item.description:
A big update for albums, events and your Profile. Albums and events can now be shaped by hand, and the new Profile brings your plan, family and gallery health together in one place.

New

  • Better albums - Photos can be added, moved or removed, the cover can be changed, and albums can be pinned or merged.
  • Make your own events - Create a new event, or add photos to an event right from the Gallery.
  • Event collections - Events are grouped into rows like Family, Gatherings and Pets, so the moments that matter are easier to find.
  • New Profile - Your plan, family and gallery health in one place, plus tips for features you might have missed.
  • Interests - Pick what you love to photograph and find those photos in one tap.
  • Milestones - Earn badges as you clean up and organize your gallery.
  • Pin to top - Favorite photos can be kept at the top of the Gallery.
  • Add photos to people - A photo can be added to someone even when their face isn't visible, like a baby or someone facing away. Find it in the photo's Labels.

Enhanced

  • Photo editor - Edits can be undone and redone. Hold the photo to see the original.
  • Name suggestions - Names you've already used are suggested as you type.
  • Events - Smoother swiping between events.
  • History - Album, pin and event changes can now be undone too.

Fixed

  • Smart Search works again after updating from an older version.
  • Photos in Trash no longer appear in albums.
  • People's profile pictures no longer change on their own.
  • Events keep their name and tags when more photos are added later.
  • General speed and stability improvements.

item.title: Version 3.1.1
item.dc:creator: Filtored
item.description:
Group Chats cleanup now groups photos by week or month, lets you choose what's never suggested for deletion, and lets you name people while you clean.

New

  • Weekly & Monthly view - Photos saved from chat apps can be viewed by day, week or month, so a whole week or month can be cleared at once. Current periods show as "This week" or "This month".
  • What to keep - Pets, scenery, food, documents and your own labels can be excluded from deletion suggestions in Group Chats and On This Day. People you've named are always kept. In Group Chats, On This Day or Organize, open the preferences icon.
  • Same-name check - When two people get the same name, Filtored offers to combine them into one. This can be undone from History.
  • What's New - Update notes are available in the app, from the Gallery or your Profile, with a link to the full patch notes.

Enhanced

  • Date picker - One-tap options like "Last 7 days", "This month" and "Last year", plus any single day or range.
  • Faces in Group Chats - Faces without a name appear at the top and can be named with a tap. Their photos are then kept. "Family photos" is renamed "Suggested to keep".
  • Events without screenshots - Screenshots no longer appear in Events, so events show only your photos, and a screenshot taken in between no longer joins two separate events into one. The Screenshots filter in Events is removed, since it's no longer needed.
  • Video sorting - Large Videos can be sorted by size or length, so the ones taking the most space can be found first.
  • Deleting - The delete confirmation can be turned off until the app is closed. After deleting, the space freed is shown, with a shortcut to Trash.
  • Scroll position - Group Chats stays where you were after opening a group or deleting photos.
  • Space freed - Cleanup shows the total space freed so far.
  • Smart Search glow - The search bar glows while Smart Search is on, so it's clear which search type is active.

Fixed

  • Deleted photos no longer reappear in Duplicates.
  • Naming someone in Group Chats now moves their photos to "Suggested to keep".
  • "Open profile" on a photo now opens the person's full page.
  • Some people's pages now open instead of showing "try again in a moment".
  • Naming people in Group Chats no longer lags.
  • On Android, large cleanups now show the full amount of space freed.
  • General speed and stability improvements.

item.title: Version 3.1.0
item.dc:creator: Filtored
item.description:
Undo is here. Filtored now keeps a history of the changes you make to people, profiles and tags, and any of them can be reversed. Your existing names, merges and tags are kept when you update.

New

  • History & Undo - see your recent changes in Settings → History, grouped by type: merges, moved faces, names and roles, hidden profiles, profile photos, tags and more. Tap any change to undo it, including changes Filtored made automatically.
  • Undo with care - if later changes depend on the one you're undoing, Filtored shows you what will be affected and lets you undo them together.
  • Recent Smart Searches - tap the search field to see your latest Smart Searches and run one again in a tap.

Enhanced

  • Manage profile - Manage faces is now Manage profile, with all the tools for cleaning up a person in one place.
  • Fewer repeat suggestions - Similar faces no longer keeps suggesting profiles you've chosen to keep apart, unless they become a much closer match.
  • More accurate Smart Search - better ranking across your whole library, and more results for everyday searches like "people smiling" or "a group of people".
  • Better text search - photos are rescanned after updating to find Hebrew text that was missed before.

Fixed

  • Fixed a bug where faces you moved by hand could be moved again during background cleanup.
  • Fixed a bug where Similar faces could show outdated thumbnails after removing a profile from the list.
  • General stability and performance improvements.

item.title: Version 3.0.0
item.dc:creator: Filtored
item.description:
A new on-device recognition engine. Filtored refreshes your library after updating - people you've named or edited stay exactly as they are, other face groups and Smart Search are rebuilt in the background. Search may be incomplete for a while during this first scan.

New

  • New face recognition engine - people are recognized by a new on-device model. Everyone you've named, hidden, merged or confirmed is carried over and kept in place.
  • Hebrew & Russian text search - Filtored now reads Hebrew and Russian text in your photos, so you can find screenshots, signs, receipts and documents by the words in them.
  • Merge into… - in Manage faces, when a whole profile is someone you already have, merge it into the right person in one step.
  • Restore purchases - get Premium back on a new phone or after reinstalling, with clear guidance if the purchase is on a different account.

Enhanced

  • Lighter Smart Search - a new, smaller model for describing what you're looking for in your own words.
  • Smoother on iPhone - swiping through photos, Cleanup, Dashboard and Large Videos no longer stall.
  • Easier "Someone else" - moving faces to another person ranks the closest matches first, everywhere you place faces.
  • Subscription details - clearer renewal terms and a Subscription manager in Settings.
  • Open-source licenses - see the third-party software Filtored uses in Settings.

Fixed

  • Fixed a race condition where fast-scrolling lists could briefly show the wrong thumbnail.
  • Fixed main-thread blocking on iOS during text and barcode recognition.
  • Fixed scan lock contention when skipping the initial scan.
  • Fixed edge cases in purchase acknowledgement.
  • Improved model loading and memory usage during background scans.
  • General stability and performance improvements.

item.title: Version 2.0.1
item.dc:creator: Filtored
item.description:
New

  • Search QR codes & barcodes - you can now search for photos that contain barcodes and QR codes.
  • Notification settings - choose which suggestions you get and how often, from every time you open the app to once a week.
  • Remove wrong search matches - if a photo shows up for the wrong word, remove that word right from the photo and it won't show up for it again.

Enhanced

  • Bulk Review Suggestions - open a notification and swipe through every suggested profile in one go.
  • Manage faces - see the original photo behind any face before moving it.
  • More accurate people - smarter face matching, fewer mix-ups in group photos, and clearer profile pictures.
  • Faster startup - people pictures now load quicker.
  • Scanning optimization - Filtored now adjusts to your phone's capabilities and adjusts speeds accordingly.
  • Tidier notifications - notifications clearing capabilities improved.

Fixed

  • Fixed a bug where speech-to-text typing could defocus from the field.
  • Fixed a bug where the app could freeze while finding duplicates in large libraries.
  • Fixed a bug where duplicate scan progress was lost if the app closed mid-scan.
  • Fixed a bug where the same photo could appear in more than one duplicate group.

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.dc:creator: Filtored
item.description:
New

  • Contextual Search - describe what you're looking for in your own words, like "kids at the beach" or "birthday cake".
  • Manage faces - spot faces that don't belong in a profile and move them to the right person, or a new one, in a tap. Remove multiple faces at once.
  • Mixed profile alerts - Filtored lets you know when a profile might include more than one person, and keeps the reminder in your notifications until you get to it.
  • Event search & saved events - find any event quickly and keep your favorites one tap away, now with holiday artwork.

Enhanced

  • Built for huge libraries - ultra-high count galleries now load, scroll, search and organize much faster.
  • Smoother scanning - the app stays fast and responsive while it organizes your library in the background.
  • Smarter scanning - scanning adjusts to your phone's capabilities and steps aside while you're using the app.
  • More accurate people - better grouping of the same person, fewer mix-ups between lookalikes, and better handling of kids and babies.
  • Tidier notifications - people suggestions are split into Merging and Managing, and show one at a time so they don't get in your way.
  • On This Day - your best memories are now separated from the clutter.
  • Similar photos are now Burst photos - clearer name, same quick cleanup.

Fixed

  • Fixed a bug where the app could freeze when opening Cleanup during a scan.
  • Fixed a bug where new photos weren't organized while the app was closed on Android.
  • Fixed a bug where some faces could be saved incorrectly and mix up people. Affected photos are fixed automatically.
  • Fixed a bug where opening a person's profile could fail.
  • Fixed a bug where renaming someone from the photo viewer showed an error.
  • Fixed memory issues during face scanning that could slow the app down over time.

  • Fixed a bug where sharing a photo stored in iCloud came back empty.

  • Fixed memory management issues that could cause slowness and crashes.

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.dc:creator: Filtored
item.description:
New

  • On This Day - see the photos you took on this date every year Day or Week view.
  • My Family - suggests you photos for deletion that were received from chat groups that do not include your named profiles.

Enhanced

  • Smoother people row - face pictures in the gallery now show up in steady batches instead of the screen redrawing every few faces.
  • Profiles open anywhere - tapping a person inside the cleanup screens now opens their full profile.

Fixed

  • Battery drain while idle - fixed the gallery quietly redrawing itself over and over on libraries with lots of people.
  • Stutter while scanning - fixed short freezes caused by the app writing too many background log lines while merging profiles.
  • Leftover loading - fixed photo previews that kept loading after you closed their sheet.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.dc:creator: Filtored
item.description:
New

  • Read text in photos - select any text directly from an image to copy, share, or search it online.
  • QR & barcode scanning in the photo viewer - links open with one tap.
  • Search by words inside photos, not just tags.
  • Your own labels - add custom labels to any photo or edit labels found by AI.
  • Similar Photos - find near-identical shots and clear them out.
  • Event albums rework - tag events with existing or custom tags.
  • Notifications system in the profile tab.

Enhanced

  • Faster people merging - combine similar faces much quicker and pick multiple matches at once.
  • Smooth swipe navigation - slide search and filters open naturally with your finger.
  • Drag-to-select - drag across the Events grid to select multiple photos in one go.
  • Independent filters - use category filters (People, Food, Documents) without resetting search results.
  • Live cleanup progress - see real-time progress while bulk deleting photos.
  • Instant Cleanup hub - opens right away and remembers scan counts so you don't wait.
  • Languages - Event tags and holidays are now available in Hebrew and Russian.

Fixed

  • Accidental face merges - fixed a bug where two people in one photo were grouped into one profile.
  • Grey avatars - fixed profiles getting stuck on a blank silhouette instead of showing face photos.
  • Names on profile splits - fixed names getting lost when separating mistakenly combined people.
  • Missing event albums - fixed newly tagged events occasionally losing their album.
  • Duplicate accuracy - tightened duplicate detection to stop grouping non-identical photos.
  • Scan freezing - fixed scans getting stuck mid-way and made the time remaining estimate accurate.
  • Screen layout issues - fixed text cut-offs and broken screens when using large system fonts.
  • Limited photo access - fixed new photos not being scanned when using limited Android gallery permissions.
